name: OpenWrt
description: OpenWrt is a Linux distribution for routers and embedded devices, with a full package manager and writable filesystem. Running it as a VM turns the host into a router.

notes.text: Imports a preinstalled OpenWrt image and temporarily boots it to configure WAN/LAN, even when Start VM is disabled. LAN defaults to http://192.168.1.1; login root with no initial password and set one immediately. WAN and LAN default to vmbr0: isolate them for your network.
